episodes.title: The Lost Years of a Young Life: Inside a Cult for 10 Years
episodes.description:
A powerful documentary exploring the psychological manipulation and control inside a cult through real testimonies. It follows a personal journey of belief, loss, and awakening, revealing how easily human minds can be influenced and how difficult it is to break free.

👉https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLjRnc1e_YrTXJko6n9H2wfLi-OnUsgPnE

There is so much to discover on Earth. Animals, criminals, space, science… There is so much going on that we can’t comprehend. What criminals are thinking, what processes does a science branch go through, depth of the space our world is in, how do stars, the earth and everything that ever existed come to being? Were you ever curious about this stuff?

You can learn all of it by plain perspective documentaries, shining a light on criminal psychology, natural wonders and everything about life.

Documentaries which will bend your mind and make you feel small on this earth to achieve a different perspective.
